items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: We became very good friends. And I used to go around to her mother's house and she would feed me quite a bit. Mrs. Morgan.

ctx.x: This was around 1935. 1935, yes. And naturally, we all were youngsters at that time. We became very good friends. And I used to go around to her mother's house and she would feed me quite a bit. Mrs. Morgan.
Oh, was she from Cleveland? I didn't know that.
